pages.title: Ecosystem overview
pages.description: Three products, one encrypted asset, shared reputation and activity infrastructure.

items: Pay → Credit: Shield ocUSDC in Pay, supply collateral and borrow on the canonical market.
All products → Reputation: Worker derives 28 capped signal types into tier buckets.
Vote → Credit: voterParticipation feeds ObscuraCreditScoreV2 for LLTV boosts.
Governor → Pay/Credit: Timelock executes treasury streams and factory parameter updates.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.description: Five-tier system design from client SDK to CoFHE coprocessor and Supabase persistence.

blocks.text: Private Payments (Pay) → Private Credit → Private Reputation → Private Governance (Vote). Each layer consumes signals from the prior without leaking individual amounts.

pages.title: Privacy model
pages.description: What stays encrypted, what is public by design, and when users choose to reveal.

blocks.text: Obscura stores financial amounts as euint64 ciphertext handles on-chain. Plaintext appears only at explicit user reveal, intentional public aggregates, or unavoidable bridge metadata.

items: Governor VoteCast — support, weight, reason stripped from Supabase args
Treasury/Rewards events — amount fields removed before insert
Credit market events — amount-free by contract design

blocks.title: Core Vote invariant
blocks.text: Observers learn participation and aggregates; never individual choices unless the voter opts in to self-decrypt.

items: No decryptForView in useEffect — user-triggered only
Masked UI (***) until explicit Reveal click
Contact labels and receipts in localStorage only

pages.title: Obscura Pay
pages.description: Encrypted ocUSDC payments, streams, escrows, invoices, stealth receiving, and public-mode smart accounts.

blocks.text: Obscura Pay is the payment layer on /pay. Canonical asset: ocUSDC_Pay (0xEd46020Df8abe7BB1E096f27d089F4326D223a53). Supports private EOA mode (FHE) and public ERC-4337 smart-account mode (Circle USDC).

rows: Encrypted FHE writes only; smart-account forwarding rejected (InvalidSigner)
Passkey smart account + ERC-4337 relay; no encrypted ocUSDC via AA

items: Shield — Approve USDC → shield(amount) → FHE.allowThis
Unshield — Encrypt → unshield(amtPlain, encAmt, to)
Direct send — Encrypt → confidentialTransfer(to, encAmount)
Stealth send — Derive stealth → transfer → announce() with retry
Stream V3 — createStream → setOperator → tickStream → escrow cycle
Public UserOp — Build → sign → POST /relay → poll /userop-receipt
useOcUSDCBalance — shield/unshield/reveal
useOcUSDCTransfer — direct private send
usePayStreamV3 — V3 stream create/tick
useInvoice — encrypted invoice create/pay
useStealthInbox / useStealthScan — private inbox (explicit unlock)
useActivityFeed — Supabase Realtime + 30s poll

pages.title: Obscura Credit
pages.description: Privacy-first Morpho Blue-shaped money market with encrypted positions and sealed liquidations.

blocks.text: Obscura Credit on /credit is an isolated FHE money market. Per-user supply shares, borrow shares, and collateral are euint64 handles. Public TVL and utilization remain plaintext.

blocks.title: Credit architecture
blocks.mermaid:
flowchart TB
  USER[User EOA]
  OCUSDC[ocUSDC_Pay]
  MARKET[CreditMarket]
  ROUTER[CreditRouter]
  SCORE[ScoreV2]
  AUCT[CreditAuction]
  USER --> OCUSDC --> MARKET
  USER --> ROUTER --> MARKET
  MARKET --> SCORE
  MARKET --> AUCT

blocks.text: CoFHE rate limiter requires a follow-up FHE op on the same handle: (1) cToken.confidentialTransfer(target, encAmt), then (2) target.recordWithEnc(amtPlain, encAmt2). Used for supply, borrow, repay, and collateral.

items: Overview — market status, TVL, ActivityFeed
Borrow — BorrowForm on canonical market
Position — EncryptedTiles, health factor, actions (reveal-on-demand)
Earn — supply and vaults
Liquidations — sealed auction cards
Risk — reputation, notifications, activity

pages.title: Obscura Vote
pages.description: FHE-encrypted multi-option governance with treasury, rewards, and OpenZeppelin Governor.

blocks.text: Obscura Vote on /vote provides coercion-resistant encrypted ballots (ObscuraVote V5) plus executable OZ Governor proposals. Eligibility requires ObscuraToken lastClaim > 0.

blocks.title: Production status
blocks.text: Private vote, treasury, rewards, and Governor propose/vote/queue/execute lifecycles are E2E validated on Sepolia. Worker indexes four contracts with sanitized args.

pages.title: Reputation
pages.description: Cross-product reputation pipeline from indexed events to tiered API summaries.

blocks.text: Reputation derives capped signal weights from Pay, Credit, and Vote indexed events. The worker writes obscura_reputation_events; the API aggregates into tier buckets for UI panels and Credit Score V2 inputs.

28 signal types across products: 7 Pay (payments, streams, escrows, invoices), 11 Credit (supply, borrow, repay, liquidation, vault, score), 10 Vote (participation, delegation, treasury, rewards, governor). Deduplication key: (wallet, source_app, signal_type, event_ref).

pages.title: Activity
pages.description: Indexed on-chain activity via Obscura API (authenticated) and Supabase Realtime (frontend fallback).

blocks.text: The obscura-worker indexes 51 event types from 19 live contract instances into obscura_activity. MCP and SDK read via GET /agent/activity with a bearer agent token. The Obscura app uses the same API when a token is saved at /docs/agents; without a token it falls back to Supabase Realtime (see security notes).

rows: JSON — sanitized; amounts stripped where required
Legacy — requires Bearer matching wallet when AGENT_AUTH_LEGACY_PUBLIC=false

blocks.title: Frontend hook
blocks.text: Production: use GET /agent/activity with agent token. In the Obscura app, save your token at /docs/agents → Save for Obscura app. Direct Supabase reads are blocked by RLS migration 004.

pages.title: Notifications
pages.description: Web Push pipeline with amount-free payloads and opt-in UX.

blocks.text: Notifications dispatch on obscura_activity INSERT via worker and API Realtime listeners. Payloads are generic and amount-free — no decrypted values in push body.

blocks.title: Dispatch pipeline
blocks.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  ACT[activity INSERT] --> WK[Worker dispatch]
  WK --> PREFS[notification_prefs]
  WK --> SUBS[push_subscriptions]
  PREFS --> PUSH[web-push]
  PUSH --> SW[/sw.js]
  SW --> BROWSER[Browser notification]

rows: Legacy — Bearer matching wallet when legacy=false

items: Opt-in only — user triggers permission from Settings
Service worker /sw.js handles click navigation to /pay, /credit, or /vote
Stale subscriptions removed on Web Push 404/410
Credit health alerts (useCreditAlerts) are local browser notifications, not server push

pages.title: Agent access & tokens
pages.description: Privacy-first MCP authentication — prove wallet ownership with EIP-191, issue bearer tokens, and bind agents to your wallet identity.

blocks.title: Encrypted by default · Revealed by choice
blocks.text: Agent tokens authenticate wallet-scoped metadata reads (activity, reputation, balance handles). They never decrypt FHE state and cannot bypass the reveal flow.
User MCP tools that access wallet-scoped data require OBSCURA_AGENT_TOKEN. The token is resolved server-side to your wallet — agents cannot pass arbitrary addresses for activity or reputation reads.

rows: expires_at checked on every Bearer lookup; expired → 401

blocks.text: Scopes are stored on each token and enforced on authenticated API routes. Four scopes are implemented today; pay, credit, and vote read scopes are planned.

blocks.title: Legacy wallet paths
blocks.text: GET /prefs/:wallet, /activity/:wallet, and /reputation/:wallet require a Bearer token matching the path wallet when AGENT_AUTH_LEGACY_PUBLIC=false. Prefer GET /agent/* routes.

items.title: Connect wallet
items.description: Use the panel above on Arbitrum Sepolia

items.title: Sign EIP-191 message
items.description: Proves ownership — no on-chain tx, no gas

items.title: Receive token once
items.description: obsc_at_… prefix — store in password manager or MCP env

items.title: Configure MCP
items.description: Add OBSCURA_AGENT_TOKEN to obscura-user mcpServers env

items.title: Save for Obscura app
items.description: Optional — enables in-app reputation & activity without MCP

items.description: Compromised token? Revoke immediately and regenerate

Token bound to one wallet; API rejects cross-wallet reads
